metrics.fresh_gain: P_L(naive, fresh) - P_L(choice, fresh), both under the new snapshot with new-snapshot weights; Newcombe 95% interval
metrics.kept_gain: P_L(naive, stale) - P_L(choice, stale), both simulated under the new snapshot and decoded with old-snapshot weights; Newcombe 95% interval (R3-D4)
metrics.kept_gain_new_weights: the same with new-snapshot weights (context, R3-D2)
metrics.m6: kept_gain / fresh_gain, only where the fresh gain's interval has a lower end at least half its estimate (P1-4); 95% percentile interval from 10,000 parametric bootstrap draws of every count involved (binomial at its pooled rate), seeded by bootstrap_seed and the case and method
